summary: Configure existing Host-owned independent Reviewer model chain without hard-coding, preserving fail-closed admission, SHA-bound review and no-tools isolation. User separately authorized the original frozen code SHA 7834bd3 static review and a fresh DeepSeek review for its manifest-only successor; neither is a reusable Host-admission bypass.

components.owning_subsystem: Existing HostReviewAdmission, SubAgentRunner, Settings and factory wiring
components.disposition: REUSE existing Host review admission and model resolver; replace fixed internal preference with operator-only configured chain. No new approval path or reviewer authority.
evidence: Frozen original code SHA 7834bd3bb3b615e315a9ad98c3f121328322da35; 361 focused tests; DeepSeek-v4-flash independent read-only review PASS P0/P1=0, P2=8, not a Host admission PASS.
Original full R9 CLEAN exit 0 on exact code SHA: Python 15378 passed, 162 skipped, 3 xfailed; WebUI Vitest 600 passed; Ruff and Pyright complete.
GitHub PR #44 A.5 requires one changed manifest covering exact 9 source/test paths plus manifest; no runtime source change is proposed in this follow-up.
components.verification_level: Manifest-only successor requires new exact-SHA review/verification and PR CI; never claim original review/R9 automatically applies to a changed tree.
components.model_evidence_veto_recovery_exit: Parent Agent cannot select Reviewer model or sign PASS. Missing/mismatched runner model fails closed; if configured model fails, stop or bounded fallback; independent Reviewer P0/P1 findings block merge and trigger re-review.
components.rollback_route: Revert the manifest-only successor and the 3 original code commits (6e5224a864e261006447ba5ce831b7a97b9c2414, 86d98585258dbc0709e07e939c2f41288b2294bd, 7834bd3bb3b615e315a9ad98c3f121328322da35) via controlled GitHub PR revert; retain previous Host admission/default chain until managed deployment is qualified.

g1.necessity: Fixed Reviewer model selection is brittle during provider rate-limit or availability incidents. Host-operator configurable preference permits an already registered DeepSeek-v4-flash reviewer when explicitly selected, without granting the parent Agent model-choice or Host-admission bypass authority.

g2.authority_owner: Existing HostReviewAdmission and SubAgentRunner remain sole independent-review execution and qualification authorities.
g2.non_duplication: No second reviewer gate, policy ledger, model approval service, or parent-selected reviewer model; Settings supplies only operator preference.

model_evidence: Independent DeepSeek-v4-flash static review PASS P0=0/P1=0 on original frozen code SHA; ordinary model PASS is not Host review_admission PASS.

361 focused tests and original full R9 CLEAN on frozen code SHA; real SubAgentRunner positive model attestation test plus fake-runner negative tests for missing/mismatched model labels. No claim of a real-runner negative test.
g3.recovery_or_reason: Invalid explicit model list fails closed; missing or mismatched model attestation terminates/rejects child; bounded retries may choose next configured model. Do not silently certify unknown actual provider weights.

g4.rollback: Revert code and manifest commits under managed release; preserve prior Host default and live service until CAS/idle checks allow switching.
verification: Validate exact 10-path A.5 manifest coverage and independent review on manifest-only successor SHA.
Run original full R9 on exact successor and require GitHub PR CI and post-merge push CI green.
Mac managed deployment requires all service idle, desired/live identity and generation CAS, rollback available; no forced restart.
